title: AI Therapy Bot for Neurodivergents
excerpt: Neuro+ GBrain offers an AI-powered therapy chatbot designed for neurodivergents, providing online mental wellness support, emotional care, and cognitive guidance
content_html:
How it works (Simple 3 steps)

  • Start chatting with the AI
  • Describe your feelings
  • Get supportive responses & coping tools

How Our AI Life Coach Works

Neuro+ offers AI-powered therapeutic tools designed for neurodivergent individuals. Improve emotional wellbeing with an experimental AI life coach and supportive mental wellness tools.

Who is it for ?

Neuro+ is an experimental AI-based life coach bot designed to support neurodivergent users in managing emotions, burnout, anxiety, and daily overwhelm

  • Autism
  • ADHD
  • Anxiety
  • Highly sensitive individuals
  • Emotional dysregulation

Advanced AI Solutions
